basic_info.description:
This beautiful 2 bedroom 2 bathroom live/work loft has a grand two-story living room with a wall of windows and an open kitchen perfect for entertaining. Completely renovated in 2018 with new bathrooms (new Whirlpool washer and dryer) and kitchen (new Bosch dishwasher).

In this unit, you will also find lots of storage space with new customized closets in the living room and huge dresser in the bedroom upstairs. There are also storage cabinets under the stairs to maximize the space. Natural light is amazing in this unit with sun roof, remote control curtains and the patio outside.

From the very first moment you enter 175 Bluxome, your senses will be enveloped. Feel the cool industrial tile as you pass through the entrance into the bamboo courtyard. Hear the sounds of the serene fountain as it lulls the urban jungle outside. Witness the shimmering bamboo as it sways gently in the wind, bringing a sense of the great outdoors inside. Surrounded by Caltrain, tech start-ups, AT&T Park, and the finest wine bars and restaurants, this exceptional live/work building at 175 Bluxome creates an incomparably intimate and exclusive living experience in the heart of one of the world's most vibrant cities. Amenities for loft homes at 175 Bluxome for all to enjoy include an airy courtyard, a water feature, trash deposits on each floor, on-site maintenance, and package storage.

Located at the intersection of SOMA, South Beach, and Mission Bay, you are perfectly situated in the heart of all that San Francisco has to offer with close proximity to Mission Bay, UCSF, Oracle Park, the newly built Chase Stadium, SOMA, Potrero Hill, the Design Center, and South Beach. 175 Bluxome is conveniently located to technology's most exciting companies including AirBnB, Advent Software, Adobe, AVG Technologies, Cisco, Pinterest, Twitter, and Zynga. This SOMA/Mission Bay/Mid-Market location is also near the Financial District, Union Square, and the historic Ninth Circuit Federal Building. A few blocks away, Mint Plaza offers Blue Bottle Coffee, and Mint 54. You are also close to the Westfield Shopping Center, the Metreon (home of the City Target), Whole Foods, and several of San Francisco's hottest restaurants including District, Saison, Benu, Bluxome Street Winery and Local Brewing Co. The location offers easy access to public transportation and freeways to the East and South Bay.

Description:
- Gorgeous large open loft style condo floor plan
- Stunning oversized windows
- Top floor private master bedroom and bathroom
- Lower private bedroom + hallway bathroom.
- Washer + Dryer
- In-unit closets

Location:
- Intersection of SOMA, South Beach, Mission Bay
- Just around the corner from Caltrain 4th & King Station!
- Close proximity to Oracle Park, Chase Stadium, Design District, UCSF campuses, Potrero Hill, and steps from the heart of the city.
- Convenient HWY Freeway access: 280 + 101.
- Prime location for all the action and excitement that comes with city life!

Terms:
- 12 month lease minimum
- Move-in cost: first month ($3,950) + Security Deposit ($3,950)
- Rental Application + Credit Check Required ($45 application fee per adult)
- Additional application: Government sanctioned photo IDs, Paystubs/Proof of Employment, and rental references.
- Pets are okay
- Parking is not included
